title: How to Make a Paper Airplane

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Start with a rectangular sheet of paper. Fold it in half lengthwise, crease it firmly, and then unfold it.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fold both top corners inward until their edges meet along the center crease.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Fold the paper in half along the original center crease. Fold both sides downward to form the wings.
